> [#17858](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/17858)
> 
> [@AbigailJixiangyuyu](https://github.com/AbigailJixiangyuyu) I don't understand why gnome-terminal can copy and paste text without `wl-clipboard` in wayland but opencode cannot. Isn't there a more native way to support it without additional packages?

I guess the reason is that gnome-terminal can copy because it is the terminal emulator itself and has direct access to the desktop clipboard. However, opencode runs as a child process inside the terminal, so it does not automatically get the same access. What's more, the code already tries the terminal-native route via OSC 52, then falls back to wl-copy / xclip / xsel.
Closing this PR as it is a duplicate of #17867. The #17867 PR covers the same modules (Editor, Selection, Clipboard) plus additional Filesystem utilities.

### 更新：已修复潜在问题

我已将 `getDirSize()` 函数从使用外部 `du` 命令改为纯 Node.js 实现，避免在 CI 环境中出现兼容性问题。

**修改内容**：
- ❌ 移除：`Process.text(["du", "-s", dir])`
- ✅ 改用：递归 `fs.readdir` + `fs.stat` 计算目录大小
- ✅ 添加：深度限制防止无限递归
- ✅ 跳过：`.git` 目录避免不必要的遍历

**优点**：
- 无外部依赖，纯 Node.js 实现
- 跨平台兼容性更好
- 在 CI 环境中更可靠
